resources.string: On = Enhanced (~$0.43/hr). Off = Standard (~$0.24/hr). Applies to the next session — stop & start to switch.
✕ Enter a wss:// URL and a token
This phone may stop the capture when the screen locks. Tap below to allow background running, and on Samsung also exclude this app from Device Care → Sleeping apps.
Notifications are off for this app, so mic and connection problems cannot alert you. Turn them on in Settings → Apps → Genesis Meeting Mic → Notifications.

1. Allow background running (button above, if shown).
2. VPN settings → Tailscale (gear) → turn on Always-on VPN.
3. Samsung: Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps → add BOTH Genesis Meeting Mic and Tailscale.
4. Before an important meeting, check the Microphone access tile in quick settings is on.
